verdict.rationale: Sardine's Case Management is documented as a workspace to review alerts and resolve cases, which covers the resolve part of the story. AI agents also clear false positives and route matches to analysts, and the AML agents are described as audit-ready. Nothing shows an analyst can reopen or override a decision, or that such an action leaves an audit record. Missing for 10: documented reopen of resolved cases, analyst override of decisions, audit-trail records of resolution or override actions, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can resolve a false positive and reopen or override the decision with an audit record

citations.quote: Case Management: Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
Automate KYC/AML alert reviews and speed up investigations with audit-ready agents.
